name: Blazeo (formerly ApexChat)
description_en:
Blazeo, formerly ApexChat, provides managed lead intake through website chat and related voice, scheduling and lead-management services. Its current chat offering combines AI for initial answers and qualification with trained human agents for escalation. This is a service configuration decision as well as a software choice: approved business information, qualification questions, coverage hours and the next human owner determine the result.

For a hypothetical home-service inquiry, collect service and location, check eligibility, request human help when needed and pass context into an appointment or staff follow-up. Chat, AI-only chat, voice and SmartHub are separate offerings, not automatically one purchased package. The profile reviews public vendor material without running a widget, intake, CRM sync, calendar booking or purchase.
description_zh:
Blazeo原名ApexChat，通过网站聊天及相关语音、预约、线索管理服务提供托管线索接待。当前聊天将AI初步回答及筛选，与受训真人接手结合。它既是服务配置决策，也涉及软件选择：获准业务资料、筛选问题、覆盖时间及下一位负责人决定结果。

以假设家居服务咨询为例，应收集服务与地区、核对资格、必要时请求真人，再将上下文传入预约或员工跟进。聊天、纯AI聊天、语音及SmartHub是不同产品，不自动属于同一购买套餐。本档案研究公开厂商资料，未操作组件、接待、CRM同步、日历预约或购买。

core_features.name_zh: 保留上下文的真人交接

core_features.explanation_en: Eligible prospects can be offered a calendar-based next step under the selected workflow.
core_features.explanation_zh: 合格潜客可按所选流程获得基于日历的下一步。

en: Pilot after-hours website intake for a local service business with clear escalation ownership.

faq.question_en: Is ApexChat a different current product from Blazeo?
faq.answer_en: The assigned ApexChat domain redirects to Blazeo, whose official biography names ApexChat as its former name. This record follows that verified identity while retaining the original slug.
faq.answer_zh: 所分配ApexChat域名跳转Blazeo，后者官方介绍将ApexChat列为曾用名。本记录按核实身份整理并保留原slug。

faq.question_en: Does a captured lead mean an appointment is confirmed?
faq.question_zh: 采集到线索代表预约已确认吗？
faq.answer_en: No. Qualification, handoff, calendar availability and successful booking are distinct steps. The public journey does not establish a tested confirmation or conflict-recovery mechanism.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。筛选、交接、日历空档及预约成功是不同步骤；公开流程不证明已测试确认或冲突恢复机制。

sections.title_en: Follow the ApexChat identity into the current managed service
sections.title_zh: 沿ApexChat身份核对当前托管服务
sections.en:
The assigned apexchat.com address redirects to Blazeo. Blazeo’s official company biography explicitly identifies its former ApexChat name, establishing continuity without borrowing features from an unrelated vendor. The current offering extends beyond a chat widget into managed intake, voice services, appointments and SmartHub. This record focuses on the chat decision while keeping those adjacent services separate.

Its main task is turning an inquiry into actionable follow-up for a service business. A law firm, home-service company or clinic can define questions and escalation, but the vendor’s displayed lead increases, client totals and testimonials are not independently measured results. The buyer needs to evaluate the quality and ownership of an intake, not assume that any chat response is a qualified sale.
sections.zh:
所分配apexchat.com地址跳转Blazeo，后者官方介绍明确其曾用名ApexChat，因此可核实身份延续，无需借用无关厂商功能。当前产品已扩展至托管接待、语音、预约及SmartHub。本记录聚焦聊天选择，同时区分这些相邻服务。

主要任务是将咨询转为服务商可跟进事项。律所、家居服务商或诊所可制定问题与升级，但页面展示的线索增幅、客户数及评价并非独立测量结果。购买者需评估接待质量及归属，不能将任何聊天回复当作合格成交。

sections.title_en: Specify the approved answers and the human escalation
sections.title_zh: 规定获准回答及真人接手
sections.en:
For an illustrative HVAC inquiry, configure service area, service type, urgency, contact information and appointment readiness. The current chat page says AI starts with approved business information, handles routine questions and collects qualification context. A trained human can join for complexity, buying intent or an explicit visitor request, seeing the history already collected.

That documented handoff does not settle wait time, out-of-coverage behavior, human capacity or who owns an urgent exception. Agree approved statements, forbidden promises and a reachable destination. Test a request outside the service area and a visitor asking for a person before publishing. Blazeo’s widget terms clarify that visitors speak to a third-party service, not directly to the website business, and that the service does not supply legal or medical advice. A qualifying conversation must not substitute for professional review or emergency handling.
sections.zh:
以假设HVAC咨询为例，可配置服务区域、类型、紧急程度、联系方式及预约意向。当前聊天页称AI依据获准业务资料开始，处理常见问题并收集筛选上下文。复杂问题、购买意向或访客明确要求时，受训真人可加入并看到既有历史。

该文档交接不能确定等待时间、覆盖范围外行为、真人容量或紧急例外负责人。应确定获准陈述、不得承诺事项及可达目标，上线前测试服务区外请求及访客要求真人。Blazeo组件条款说明访客面对第三方服务，并非直接面对网站商家，且服务不提供法律或医疗建议。筛选对话不能替代专业审查或紧急事件处理。

sections.title_en: Verify delivery and booking after qualification
sections.title_zh: 在线索筛选后验证投递与预约
sections.en:
The FAQ describes customized business scripts, email lead notification, CRM delivery and calendar-based appointment offers. It also says customers can handle their own chats with Blazeo backing them up on most service levels. That last qualifier matters: a dashboard login does not prove every plan includes the same self-staffing and overflow rights.

A complete pilot follows the collected name, location, request, contact consent and transcript to the intended staff member or CRM object, then confirms the appointment or callback. The broad claim that an open-API CRM can integrate does not establish a ready-made connector, field map, retry queue or duplicate prevention. Likewise, visible calendar availability is not a tested reservation. Inspect a failed delivery, a calendar conflict and a human takeover in the chosen package. No live interaction was performed for this profile.
sections.zh:
FAQ描述定制业务话术、邮件线索通知、CRM投递及基于日历的预约邀请。它还称大部分服务档允许客户自接聊天，由Blazeo补位；这一限定很关键，拥有面板登录不证明所有套餐都包含相同自接与溢出权益。

完整试点应将姓名、地区、需求、联系同意及聊天记录追踪至目标员工或CRM对象，再确认预约或回电。开放API的CRM可集成这一宽泛主张，不能证明现成连接器、字段映射、重试队列或去重。显示日历空档也不是测试过的预约。应按所选套餐检查投递失败、日历冲突及真人接管。本档案未执行真实互动。

sections.title_en: Keep managed chat, AI-only and voice budgets distinct
sections.title_zh: 分别计算托管聊天、纯AI与语音预算
sections.en:
The pricing page advertises managed live chat from$49/month and AI chatbot from$39/month. Both display traffic/user bands: Grow1–500 traffic and one user, Pro500–2000 and five, Pro+2000–5000 and five, Advanced5000–10000 and ten. Additional qualifiers also vary. The page does not establish the traffic period or exact higher-tier cash prices in the read text; do not turn unlimited customer interactions into unlimited traffic, users or services. Visual comparison marks were not used to infer every tier entitlement.

Voice is a separate cost model. Human call-center plans start at$249/month with75 minutes in Grow; the page lists extra minutes at$3.83 for Grow, decreasing across larger plans. Voice AI also starts at$249 but lists125 Grow minutes and$1.99 extra per minute. These distinct allowances are not interchangeable with chat. Confirm setup, contract length, currency, channels, minute rounding, traffic overages and human escalation charges in the selected quote. No ongoing free plan or trial entitlement was established.
sections.zh:
价格页宣传托管聊天每月$49起、AI聊天$39起。两者显示流量／用户档：Grow流量1—500及1用户，Pro500—2000及5用户，Pro+2000—5000及5用户，Advanced5000—10000及10用户，附加筛选项也不同。所读文本未确定流量周期及高档准确现金价，不能把不限客户互动扩展为不限流量、用户或服务，也未根据视觉勾选表推断所有档位权益。

语音采用独立成本模型。真人呼叫中心每月$249起，Grow含75分钟，额外分钟Grow列$3.83，较大套餐递减。语音AI同样$249起，但Grow列125分钟及每额外分钟$1.99。这些额度不能与聊天互换。应在所选报价确认设置费、合同期限、币种、渠道、分钟取整、流量超额及真人升级费用。此次未确定持续免费档或试用权益。

sections.title_en: Evaluate an outsourced intake boundary, not just a widget
sections.title_zh: 评估外包接待边界，而不只看组件
sections.en:
Blazeo is a plausible evaluation candidate when a service business wants after-hours or overflow intake without staffing every conversation itself. A team requiring a deeply documented self-service automation engine, guaranteed response timing or a particular integration should resolve those needs against the actual package; public sales descriptions do not establish them. The FAQ states English and Spanish human-chat capability, not universal multilingual UI or AI support.

Operations need an owner for changing approved answers, reviewing disqualified leads and checking missed handoffs. Widget-user terms disclose transcript retention and sharing with the business and service partners, but do not specify the merchant’s export, deletion, restore or service-level remedies. Merchant subscription and data-processing terms were not established here. Review representative export and cancellation requirements before relying on the service as the sole intake record.
sections.zh:
对于希望在非营业或高峰时段接待、又不自行值守所有对话的服务商，Blazeo具有可评估价值。需要深度文档化自助自动化引擎、保证响应时限或指定集成的团队，应按实际套餐解决，公开销售描述不能证明。FAQ列英语及西班牙语真人聊天，不代表全语言界面或AI支持。

运营需有人负责更新获准回答、复核不合格线索及检查遗漏交接。组件用户条款披露聊天留存及与商家、服务伙伴分享，但未确定商户导出、删除、恢复或服务级别救济。此次未确定商户订阅及数据处理协议。在将其作为唯一接待记录前，应核对代表性导出及取消要求。
